subject: website
name: Resupply
summary: Resupply's stablecoin app. No public source was found for this frontend: the project's public repository holds its smart contracts only, so it stays at Level 2. When it opens it reads chain data from a dRPC endpoint, prices from DefiLlama and Curve's API, and contacts WalletConnect's servers. What it reaches after a wallet connects was not checked.

connections.name: Price APIs (DefiLlama's coins.llama.fi, api.curve.finance)
connections.note: Centralised sources, read when the page opens.

connections.name: WalletConnect's servers (pulse.walletconnect.org, api.web3modal.org)
connections.note: Contacted when the page opens, before any wallet is connected.
